title: Grease interceptors and automatic grease removal devices not required.
officialText:
A grease interceptor or an automatic grease
removal device shall not be required for individual dwelling units, any private living quarters, or non-culinary schools which only
contain residential type stoves and sinks intended for teaching basic home cooking skills.
